name: Society of Critical Care Medicine 2027 Critical Care Congress
description: The Critical Care Congress is the Society of Critical Care Medicine's annual meeting on critical care research and practice. The 2027 congress runs March 14 to 16 at the San Diego Convention Center, preceded by precongress educational programming on March 12 and 13.
